[Verse 1]
[B5]Six bottles went down the drain,
[D#5]one hour's a waste [F#/A#]of time,
[B5]I’d ask if you feel the same,
[D#5]still pushing that chance [F#/A#]to try,
[B5]your breath in this cool room chill,
[D#5]long hair that blows side [F#/A#]to side,
[B5]you speak and make time stand still,
[D#5]and each time walk [F#/A#]right on by
[B5]

[Chorus]
[B5]Like violence
[C#5]you have me,
[G#5]forever,
[A#5]and after
[B5]Like violence
[C#5]you kill me,
[G#5]forever
[A#5]and after.

[Verse 2]
[B5]Can’t count on the eyes that stare,
[D#5]can’t count on the things [F#/A#]they see,
[B5]she kills with no life to spare,
[D#5]just victim to left [F#/A#]to bleed,
[B5]one drink and the pain goes down,
[D#5]soft shadows lay by [F#/A#]her feet,
[B5]lay soft as you slowly drown,
[D#5]lay still as you fall [F#/A#]asleep.
[B5](Fall asleep)
